item.title: Using Gemini CLI on a Server
item.description: 1. Get the Project ID and API Key Visit https://aistudio.google.com/apikey Get the project ID and API key, and set them as environment variables 1 2 echo "export GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT=" >> ~/.bashrc echo "export GEMINI_API_KEY=" >> ~/.bashrc 1 source ~/.bashrc 2. Prepare the Node.js Environment Install nvm 1 curl -o- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvm-sh/nvm/v0.40.3/install.sh |
